feat: add comprehensive admin and support system with RBAC

Implement enterprise-grade admin and support modules with role-based
access control, user management, system monitoring, and customer support
ticketing functionality.

## Features

### Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
- Add three-tier role hierarchy (ADMIN > SUPPORT > USER)
- Implement RolesGuard for centralized authorization
- Add @Roles() decorator for declarative access control
- Store roles in database as source of truth

### Admin Module
- User management with pagination and filters
- Suspend/unsuspend user accounts with reason tracking
- Update user roles (promote/demote)
- Permanent user deletion with safeguards
- System statistics and health monitoring
- Searchable audit log access

### Support Module
- Create and manage support tickets
- Message threading with internal notes support
- Role-based ticket visibility (users see only own tickets)
- Status workflow (OPEN → IN_PROGRESS → RESOLVED → CLOSED)
- Activity tracking for all ticket changes
- Automatic status transitions based on responder

### Security Enhancements
- Account suspension blocks access at JWT validation level
- Redis-backed distributed rate limiting (14 new profiles)
- All admin actions logged via AuditLoggingInterceptor
- Prevent self-operations (can''t suspend/delete self)
- Protect admin accounts from deletion by non-admins

## Database Changes

### Schema Additions
- Add role field to User model (enum: ADMIN, SUPPORT, USER)
- Add suspension tracking fields (suspendedAt, suspendedReason, suspendedBy)
- Create SupportTicket model with auto-incrementing ticket numbers
- Create TicketMessage model with internal notes support
- Create TicketActivity model for audit trail
- Add 4 new enums (Role, TicketCategory, TicketPriority, TicketStatus)

### Bug Fixes
- Fix duplicate relation field name in UserHealthCondition model

## API Endpoints

### Admin Endpoints (/admin)
- GET /users - List users with filters (30/min)
- GET /users/:id - Get user details (100/min)
- POST /users/:id/suspend - Suspend user (10/min)
- POST /users/:id/unsuspend - Restore user (10/min)
- PATCH /users/:id/role - Update role (10/min)
- DELETE /users/:id - Delete user (5/min)
- GET /stats - System statistics (60/min)
- GET /audit-logs - Search logs (50/min)

### Support Endpoints (/support/tickets)
- POST / - Create ticket (5/min)
- GET / - List tickets (100/min)
- GET /:id - Get details (100/min)
- PATCH /:id - Update ticket (30/min)
- POST /:id/messages - Add message (50/min)
- POST /:id/close - Close ticket (30/min)
